caption:
Race to forgiveness before you race to work

Allah calls the believers to race one another towards forgiveness from their Lord and a Paradise as wide as the heaven and earth. Start your morning in that race.

Surah Al-Hadid 57:21

Name one good deed you will get to first today

#raceforjannah #seekforgiveness #morningreminder #quranreels

Recitation: Yasser Al-Dosari
alt_text: Race one another towards forgiveness from your Lord and Paradise the width of which is like the width of the heaven and earth, prepared for those who believe in Allah and His messengers. That is the bounty of Allah which He gives to whom He wills, for Allah is the Lord of great bounty (Surah Al-Hadid 57:21)
theme: racing to good / forgiveness and Paradise
review: approve r1: Arabic and English checked on card and Reel, caption faithful

ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ أُعِدَّتۡ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦۚ ذَٰلِكَ
فَضۡلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤۡتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلۡفَضۡلِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ ٢١
